label: SC-45(1)
title: Synchronization with Authoritative Time Source

children.label: (a)
children.prose: Compare the internal system clocks {{ insert: param, sc-45.01_odp.01 }} with {{ insert: param, sc-45.01_odp.02 }} ; and

children.label: (b)
children.prose: Synchronize the internal system clocks to the authoritative time source when the time difference is greater than {{ insert: param, sc-45.01_odp.03 }}.

guidance: Synchronization of internal system clocks with an authoritative source provides uniformity of time stamps for systems with multiple system clocks and systems connected over a network.

params.label: frequency
guidelines: the frequency at which to compare the internal system clocks with the authoritative time source is defined;

params.label: authoritative time source
guidelines: the authoritative time source to which internal system clocks are to be compared is defined;

params.label: time period
guidelines: the time period to compare the internal system clocks with the authoritative time source is defined;
